business_summary: Hirakawa Hewtech Corp. manufactures and sells cable and assemblies, electric and electronic equipment, and medical equipment and parts in Japan, the United States, China, Asia, and internationally. The company offers semi-flexible coaxial cords and semi-rigid coaxial cords for internal wiring and connection of high-frequency equipment; high speed cables; ultra-thin coaxial cables for medical precision equipment; interface cables for digital signals, including industry-certified products; factory automation cables; broadcast cables and optical fiber cables; UL/CSA standard wires; insulated wires and shield insulated wires for internal wiring of various electrical and electronic devices; power cords and power supply components; wiring protection tubes; harness for internal wiring materials for multimedia-related industrial equipment and connection wires between equipment; and other products. It also provides optical transmission devices, network equipment, optical camera modules, and AC normal charger for EV/PHEV. In addition, the company engages in the development, manufacture, and sale of special medical tubing, as well as related processed goods used in medical, analysis equipment, and other special industrial fields; design, execution, and management and contract work of electrical and telecommunications work; and leasing and management of real estate. Hirakawa Hewtech Corp. was formerly known as Hirakawa Electric Wire Corporation and changed its name to Hirakawa Hewtech Corp. in October 1990. The company was incorporated in 1948 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
